```{r stats}
# BH-adjusted Wilcoxon + log2FC per gene, for two comparisons vs ATRXdel
.nk_stats <- Seurat::FetchData(ALL_NK,
                                vars = c(gene_of_interest, "group"),
                                layer = "data") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = dplyr::all_of(gene_of_interest),
                      names_to = "gene", values_to = "expr") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(gene) %>%
  dplyr::group_modify(~ {
    dd <- .x
    purrr::map_dfr(list(c("ATRXdel","control"),
                        c("ATRXdel","ATRXwtMYCNwt"), 
                        c("ATRXdel","MYCNamp")), 
                   function(grps) {
      sub <- dplyr::filter(dd, group %in% grps)
      sub$group <- factor(sub$group, levels = grps)
      w <- tryCatch(
        rstatix::wilcox_test(sub, expr ~ group, exact = FALSE) %>%
          rstatix::adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>%
          rstatix::add_significance("p.adj",
            cutpoints = c(0, 0.0001, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 1),
            symbols   = c("****", "***", "**", "*", "ns")),
        error = function(e) data.frame(p.adj.signif = "ns")
      )
      fc <- log2((mean(sub$expr[sub$group == "ATRXdel"]) + 0.01) /
                  (mean(sub$expr[sub$group == grps[2]])   + 0.01))
      data.frame(comparison = paste(grps, collapse = " vs "),
                 grp2 = grps[2],
                 signif = w$p.adj.signif[1],
                 log2FC = round(fc, 2))
    })
  }) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

.nk_stats

# per NK subset - per group
Idents(ALL_NK) <- ALL_NK$predicted_NK_type_de.n350
NK2_NK3 <- subset(ALL_NK, idents = c("hNK_Bm2", "hNK_Bm3"))

      data.frame(comparison = paste(grps, collapse = " vs "),
```

```{r RUNX3-nk-dot, fig.height=4, fig.width=6}
p_RUNX3_dot <- do_DotPlot(
  ALL_NK,
  features     = gene_of_interest,
  group.by     = "group",
  scale        = TRUE,
  dot.scale    = 12,
  font.size    = 12,
  dot_border   = FALSE,
  use_viridis  = TRUE,
  viridis.palette = "A",
  viridis.direction = -1,
  colors.use   = GRADIENT_COLORS_v2
)

# detect y-axis group order from the built plot
.pb       <- ggplot_build(p_RUNX3_dot)
.y_groups <- .pb$layout$panel_params[[1]]$y$limits 
.x_range  <- .pb$layout$panel_params[[1]]$x.range

.y_pos <- function(grp) which(.y_groups == grp)
.x_brk1 <- .x_range[2] + 0.20 * diff(.x_range)   # ATRXdel vs ATRXwtMYCNwt
.x_brk2 <- .x_range[2] + 0.55 * diff(.x_range)   # ATRXdel vs control
.x_brk3 <- .x_range[2] + 0.75 * diff(.x_range)   # ATRXdel vs MYCNamp
.x_tick  <- 0.06 * diff(.x_range)

.make_cmp <- function(grp2, x_brk) {
  sub <- dplyr::filter(.nk_stats, grp2 == !!grp2) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(factor(gene, levels = CD6_NB_GENES))
  lbl <- paste(paste0(sub$gene, ": ", sub$signif, " (FC=", sub$log2FC, ")"),
               collapse = "\n")
  y1  <- .y_pos("ATRXdel")
  y2  <- .y_pos(grp2)
  list(
    ggplot2::geom_segment(data = data.frame(x_brk = x_brk, y1 = y1, y2 = y2),
      ggplot2::aes(y = y1, yend = y2), x = x_brk, xend = x_brk,
      inherit.aes = FALSE, color = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
    ggplot2::geom_text(data = data.frame(x_brk = x_brk + .x_tick,
                                          y_mid = (y1 + y2) / 2, label = lbl),
      ggplot2::aes(y = y_mid, label = label), x = x_brk + .x_tick,
      inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0, size = 2.2, lineheight = 0.9)
  )
}

p_RUNX3_dot <- p_RUNX3_dot +
  .make_cmp("ATRXwtMYCNwt", .x_brk1) +
  .make_cmp("control",    .x_brk2) +
  .make_cmp("MYCNamp",      .x_brk3) +
  ggplot2::coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  ggplot2::theme(plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 5, r = 120, b = 5, l = 5))

p_RUNX3_dot

ggsave(paste0(fig_out, "RUNX3_NK_dotplot_perGroup.pdf"),
       p_RUNX3_dot, width = 6, height = 4, device = cairo_pdf)
```


# ___Define CD6 locus___

```{r}
gene_anno <- getGeneAnnotation(atac)
cd6_gene  <- gene_anno$genes[which(gene_anno$genes$symbol == "CD6")]

if (length(cd6_gene) == 0) {
  # Fallback: hg38 coordinates (chr11, plus strand)
  # Source: GeneCards / UCSC, https://www.genecards.org/cgi-bin/carddisp.pl?gene=CD6
  cd6_gene <- GRanges("chr11", IRanges(60971675, 61020377), strand = "+",
                       symbol = "CD6")
  cat("CD6 gene annotation not found in project; using hg38 hardcoded coordinates.\n")
} else {
  cat("CD6 gene:", as.character(seqnames(cd6_gene)),
      start(cd6_gene), "-", end(cd6_gene),
      "strand:", as.character(strand(cd6_gene)), "\n")
}

# Extend locus to capture distal regulatory elements (promoter + flanking
# enhancers). The RUNX+T-box composite enhancer at the analogous SELL locus
# (Cichocki et al., Cell 2018, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6329660/)
# was intronic/proximal rather than far distal, so +/-10kb is a reasonable
# starting window; widen if nothing turns up.
flank <- 10000L
cd6_locus <- GRanges(
  seqnames = seqnames(cd6_gene),
  ranges   = IRanges(pmax(1L, start(cd6_gene) - flank), end(cd6_gene) + flank)
)

cat("CD6 locus (gene +/-10kb):",
    as.character(seqnames(cd6_locus)),
    start(cd6_locus), "-", end(cd6_locus), "\n")
```

## ___Peaks overlapping the CD6 locus___

```{r}
atac <- addMotifAnnotations(
  ArchRProj = atac,
  motifSet  = "cisbp",
  name      = "Motif",
  force     = TRUE   
)

stopifnot(nrow(getMatches(atac, name = "Motif")) == length(getPeakSet(atac)))
motifMatches <- getMatches(atac, name = "Motif")

peak_gr <- getPeakSet(atac)
ov_hits <- findOverlaps(peak_gr, cd6_locus, ignore.strand = TRUE)
cd6_peak_idx <- unique(queryHits(ov_hits))

cat("Peaks overlapping CD6 locus (+/-10kb):", length(cd6_peak_idx), "\n")
if (length(cd6_peak_idx) == 0) {
  stop("No peaks found at the CD6 locus with this window - widen `flank` and re-run.")
}

cd6_peaks <- peak_gr[cd6_peak_idx]
print(cd6_peaks)
```

## ___Pull existing motif matches (CIS-BP) at those peaks___

```{r}
#fixing archR file paths (different dockers have different folder bindings)
old_prefix <- "/home/rstudio/mnt_out/ArchR_v20260203"
new_prefix <- "/home/rstudio/mnt_out/NK_project/ArchR_v20260203"

for (i in seq_along(atac@peakAnnotation)) {
  if (!is.null(atac@peakAnnotation[[i]]$Positions)) {
    atac@peakAnnotation[[i]]$Positions <- gsub(old_prefix, new_prefix,
                                                atac@peakAnnotation[[i]]$Positions,
                                                fixed = TRUE)
  }
  if (!is.null(atac@peakAnnotation[[i]]$Matches)) {
    atac@peakAnnotation[[i]]$Matches <- gsub(old_prefix, new_prefix,
                                              atac@peakAnnotation[[i]]$Matches,
                                              fixed = TRUE)
  }
}

# Verify before moving on
sapply(atac@peakAnnotation, function(x) {
  c(Positions = if (!is.null(x$Positions)) file.exists(x$Positions) else NA,
    Matches   = if (!is.null(x$Matches))   file.exists(x$Matches)   else NA)
})
```


```{r}
stopifnot(nrow(getMatches(atac, name = "Motif")) == length(getPeakSet(atac)))
motifSetName <- "Motif"

motifMatches <- getMatches(atac, name = motifSetName)
cat("Motif match matrix: ", nrow(motifMatches), "peaks x", ncol(motifMatches), "motifs\n")

# Peaks in the motif match SE are indexed identically to getPeakSet(atac),
# assuming peaks haven't been re-called/re-ordered since addMotifAnnotations()
# was run. Sanity check that dimensions line up before subsetting.
stopifnot(nrow(motifMatches) == length(peak_gr))

cd6_motif_mat <- assay(motifMatches)[cd6_peak_idx, , drop = FALSE]
rownames(cd6_motif_mat) <- paste0(
  as.character(seqnames(cd6_peaks)), ":", start(cd6_peaks), "-", end(cd6_peaks)
)
```

## ___Subset to RUNX family and T-box family motifs___

```{r}
all_motif_names <- colnames(cd6_motif_mat)

# RUNX family: RUNX1, RUNX2, RUNX3 (motif names typically look like
# "RUNX1_123" or "RUNX3(var.2)" depending on the motif DB naming convention)
runx_motifs <- grep("RUNX", all_motif_names, ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)

# T-box family relevant to NK/T cytotoxic biology: TBX21 (T-bet), EOMES,
# plus other T-box family members that share the same core T-box consensus
# (Fang et al., Immunity 2022; Cichocki et al., Cell 2018 both describe
# T-box motifs broadly, not just the TBX21 PWM specifically)
tbox_motifs <- grep("TBX21|^EOMES|TBR1|TBX[0-9]", all_motif_names,
                     ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)

cat("RUNX-family motifs found in DB:", paste(runx_motifs, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("T-box-family motifs found in DB:", paste(tbox_motifs, collapse = ", "), "\n")

if (length(runx_motifs) == 0 || length(tbox_motifs) == 0) {
  warning(
    "Could not find RUNX and/or T-box motifs under these name patterns.\n",
    "Run `colnames(getMatches(atac, name = \"", motifSetName, "\"))` ",
    "and inspect naming convention, then adjust the grep patterns above."
  )
}

cd6_runx_tbox <- cd6_motif_mat[, c(runx_motifs, tbox_motifs), drop = FALSE]
print(cd6_runx_tbox)
```

## ___Summary: which CD6 peaks carry RUNX and/or T-box motifs___

```{r}
peak_summary <- data.frame(
  peak            = rownames(cd6_motif_mat),
  has_RUNX        = rowSums(cd6_motif_mat[, runx_motifs, drop = FALSE]) > 0,
  has_Tbox        = rowSums(cd6_motif_mat[, tbox_motifs, drop = FALSE]) > 0,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
peak_summary$has_RUNX_and_Tbox <- peak_summary$has_RUNX & peak_summary$has_Tbox

cat("CD6 peaks with RUNX motif:", sum(peak_summary$has_RUNX), "of", nrow(peak_summary), "\n")
cat("CD6 peaks with T-box motif:", sum(peak_summary$has_Tbox), "of", nrow(peak_summary), "\n")
cat("CD6 peaks with BOTH (candidate composite RUNX+T-box element,",
    "analogous to the SELL enhancer in Cichocki et al. 2018):",
    sum(peak_summary$has_RUNX_and_Tbox), "\n")

print(peak_summary)

write.csv(peak_summary,
          paste0(params$out, "tables/snATAC_NK_CD6_RUNX_Tbox_motif_scan.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```
